432 [[nodiscard]] inline bool IsChildOfUsingStructArray(const FStructBaseChain& Parent) const
433 {
434 int32 NumParentStructBasesInChainMinusOne = Parent.NumStructBasesInChainMinusOne;

445 // Runtime allocated or post-converstion compiled in list of bases

808 template<class T>
809 bool IsChildOf() const
810 {
811 if constexpr (TModels_V<CStaticClassProvider, T>)
812 {
813 return IsChildOf(T::StaticClass());
814 }
815 else if constexpr (TModels_V<CStaticStructProvider, T>)
816 {
817 return IsChildOf(T::StaticStruct());
818 }
819 else
820 {
821 static_assert(sizeof(T) == 0, "Unsupported type - requires StaticClass or StaticStruct.");
822 return false;
823 }
824 }

1203 template <typename CppStruct>
1204 constexpr FCapabilities GetCapabilities()
1205 {
1206 using TraitsType = TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>;
1207
1208 constexpr FCapabilities Capabilities {
1209 .ComputedPropertyFlags =
1210 (TIsPODType<CppStruct>::Value ? CPF_IsPlainOldData : CPF_None) |
1211 (std::is_trivially_destructible_v<CppStruct> ? CPF_NoDestructor : CPF_None) |
1212 (TIsZeroConstructType<CppStruct>::Value ? CPF_ZeroConstructor : CPF_None) |
1213 (TModels_V<CGetTypeHashable, CppStruct> ? CPF_HasGetValueTypeHash : CPF_None),
1214 .HasSerializerObjectReferences = TraitsType::WithSerializerObjectReferences,
1215 .HasNoopConstructor = TraitsType::WithNoInitConstructor,
1216 .HasZeroConstructor = TraitsType::WithZeroConstructor,
1217 .HasDestructor = !(TraitsType::WithNoDestructor || TIsPODType<CppStruct>::Value),
1218 .HasSerializer = TraitsType::WithSerializer,
1219 .HasStructuredSerializer = TraitsType::WithStructuredSerializer,
1220 .HasPostSerialize = TraitsType::WithPostSerialize,
1221 .HasNetSerializer = TraitsType::WithNetSerializer,
1222 .HasNetSharedSerialization = TraitsType::WithNetSharedSerialization,
1223 .HasNetDeltaSerializer = TraitsType::WithNetDeltaSerializer,
1224 .HasPostScriptConstruct = TraitsType::WithPostScriptConstruct,
1225 .IsPlainOldData = TIsPODType<CppStruct>::Value,
1226 .IsUECoreType = TIsUECoreType<CppStruct>::Value,
1227 .IsUECoreVariant = TIsUECoreVariant<CppStruct>::Value,
1228 .HasCopy = TraitsType::WithCopy,
1229 .HasMoveAssign = TraitsType::WithMoveAssign,
1230 .HasIdentical = TraitsType::WithIdentical || TraitsType::WithIdenticalViaEquality,
1231 .HasExportTextItem = TraitsType::WithExportTextItem,
1232 .HasImportTextItem = TraitsType::WithImportTextItem,
1233 .HasAddStructReferencedObjects = TraitsType::WithAddStructReferencedObjects,
1234 .HasSerializeFromMismatchedTag = TraitsType::WithSerializeFromMismatchedTag,
1235 .HasStructuredSerializeFromMismatchedTag = TraitsType::WithStructuredSerializeFromMismatchedTag,
1236 .HasGetTypeHash = TModels_V<CGetTypeHashable, CppStruct>,
1237 .HasIntrusiveUnsetOptionalState = ::HasIntrusiveUnsetOptionalState<CppStruct>(),
1238 .IsAbstract = TIsAbstract<CppStruct>::Value,
1239 .HasFindInnerPropertyInstance = TraitsType::WithFindInnerPropertyInstance,
1240 .ClearOnFinishDestroy = TraitsType::WithClearOnFinishDestroy,
1241#if WITH_EDITOR
1242 .HasCanEditChange = TraitsType::WithCanEditChange,
1243 PRAGMA_DISABLE_INTERNAL_WARNINGS
1244 .HasPostLoad = TraitsType::WithPostLoad,
1245 PRAGMA_ENABLE_INTERNAL_WARNINGS
1246#endif
1247 .HasVisitor = TraitsType::WithVisitor,
1248 .HasGetPreloadDependencies = TraitsType::WithGetPreloadDependencies,
1249 .IsIntrusiveOptionalSafeForGC = TraitsType::WithIntrusiveOptionalSafeForGC,
1250 };
1251 return Capabilities;
1252 }

1254 template <typename CppStruct>
1255 requires (!TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>::WithZeroConstructor)
1256 void Construct(void* Dest)
1257 {
1258 using TraitsType = TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>;
1259
1260#if CHECK_PUREVIRTUALS
1261 if constexpr (!TraitsType::WithPureVirtual)
1262#endif
1263 {
1264 if constexpr (TraitsType::WithNoInitConstructor)
1265 {
1266 ::new (Dest) CppStruct(ForceInit);
1267 }
1268 else
1269 {
1270 ::new (Dest) CppStruct();
1271 }
1272 }
1273 }

1280 using TraitsType = TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>;
1281
1282#if CHECK_PUREVIRTUALS
1283 if constexpr (!TraitsType::WithPureVirtual)
1284#endif
1285 {
1286 if constexpr (TraitsType::WithNoInitConstructor)
1287 {
1288 ::new (Dest) CppStruct(ForceInit);
1289 }
1290 else
1291 {
1292 // NOTE: unlike regular "Construct", no value init here! (missing "()")
1293 ::new (Dest) CppStruct;
1294 }
1295 }
1296 }
1297#endif

1369 template <typename CppStruct>
1370 requires (!!TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>::WithCopy)
1371 bool Copy(void* Dest, void const* Src, int32 ArrayDim)
1372 {
1373 static_assert((!TIsPODType<CppStruct>::Value), "You probably don't want custom copy for a POD type.");
1374
1375 CppStruct* TypedDest = (CppStruct*)Dest;
1376 const CppStruct* TypedSrc = (const CppStruct*)Src;
1377
1378 for (; ArrayDim; --ArrayDim)
1379 {
1380 *TypedDest++ = *TypedSrc++;
1381 }
1382 return true;
1383 }
1384
1385 template <typename CppStruct>
1386 requires (!!TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>::WithMoveAssign)
1387 bool MoveAssign(void* Dest, void* Src, int32 ArrayDim)
1388 {
1389 static_assert((!TIsPODType<CppStruct>::Value), "You probably don't want custom move for a POD type.");
1390
1391 CppStruct* TypedDest = (CppStruct*)Dest;
1392 CppStruct* TypedSrc = (CppStruct*)Src;
1393
1394 for (; ArrayDim; --ArrayDim)
1395 {
1396 *TypedDest++ = MoveTemp(*TypedSrc++);
1397 }
1398 return true;
1399 }

1401 // If you get an overload resolution error here, it's likely you've specified both WithIdentical and WithIdenticalViaEquality
1402 // in your TStructOpsTypeTraits, which is not supported.
1403 template <typename CppStruct>
1404 requires (!!TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>::WithIdentical)
1405 bool Identical(const void* A, const void* B, uint32 PortFlags, bool& bOutResult)
1406 {
1407 bOutResult = ((const CppStruct*)A)->Identical((const CppStruct*)B, PortFlags);
1408 return true;
1409 }
1410 template <typename CppStruct>
1411 requires (!!TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>::WithIdenticalViaEquality)
1412 bool Identical(const void* A, const void* B, uint32 PortFlags, bool& bOutResult)
1413 {
1414 bOutResult = (*(const CppStruct*)A == *(const CppStruct*)B);
1415 return true;
1416 }

1418 template <typename CppStruct>
1419 requires (!!TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>::WithExportTextItem)
1420 bool ExportTextItem(FString& ValueStr, const void* PropertyValue, const void* DefaultValue, UObject* Parent, int32 PortFlags, UObject* ExportRootScope)
1421 {
1422 if (DefaultValue)
1423 {
1424 return ((const CppStruct*)PropertyValue)->ExportTextItem(ValueStr, *(const CppStruct*)DefaultValue, Parent, PortFlags, ExportRootScope);
1425 }
1426 else
1427 {
1428 TTypeCompatibleBytes<CppStruct> TmpDefaultValue;
1429 FMemory::Memzero(TmpDefaultValue.GetTypedPtr(), sizeof(CppStruct));
1430 if constexpr (!GetCapabilities<CppStruct>().HasZeroConstructor)
1431 {
1432 Construct<CppStruct>(TmpDefaultValue.GetTypedPtr());
1433 }
1434
1435 const bool bResult = ((const CppStruct*)PropertyValue)->ExportTextItem(ValueStr, *(const CppStruct*)TmpDefaultValue.GetTypedPtr(), Parent, PortFlags, ExportRootScope);
1436
1437 if constexpr (GetCapabilities<CppStruct>().HasDestructor)
1438 {
1439 Destruct<CppStruct>(TmpDefaultValue.GetTypedPtr());
1440 }
1441
1442 return bResult;
1443 }
1444 }

1474 FName StructName;
1475 if (Tag.GetType().GetName() == NAME_StructProperty && Tag.GetType().GetParameterCount() >= 1)

1477 StructName = Tag.GetType().GetParameterName(0);

1479 return ((CppStruct*)Data)->SerializeFromMismatchedTag(StructName, Ar);

1482 {
1483 return ((CppStruct*)Data)->SerializeFromMismatchedTag(Tag, Ar);

1607 // These represent one function per optional function in the fake vtable.
1608 enum class EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags : uint32
1609 {
1610 None = 0,
1611
1612 #define UE_VTABLE_ENUM(Index, Name, Functype) Name = 1u << Index,
1613 UE_FOREACH_FAKE_VTABLE_FUNC(UE_VTABLE_ENUM)
1614 #undef UE_VTABLE_ENUM
1615 };
1616 ENUM_CLASS_FLAGS(EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags)
1617
1618 template <EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags Flag>
1619 struct THandlingFunctionType;
1620 template <typename CppStruct, EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags Flag>
1621 struct THandlingFunctionPtr;
1622
1623 #define UE_VTABLE_FUNC(Index, Name, Functype) \
1624 template <> \
1625 struct THandlingFunctionType<EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags::Name> \
1626 { \
1627 using Type = Functype; \
1628 }; \
1629 template <typename CppStruct> \
1630 struct THandlingFunctionPtr<CppStruct, EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags::Name> \
1631 { \
1632 inline static constexpr TIdentity_T<Functype>* Value = &Name<CppStruct>; \
1633 };
1634 UE_FOREACH_FAKE_VTABLE_FUNC(UE_VTABLE_FUNC)
1635 #undef UE_VTABLE_FUNC
1636
1637 template <typename CppStruct>
1638 constexpr EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags GetStructOpsFakeVTableFlags()
1639 {
1640 using TraitsType = TStructOpsTypeTraits<CppStruct>;
1641
1642 EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags Result = EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags::None;
1643
1644 #define UE_VTABLE_SETFLAG(Index, Name, Functype) \
1645 if constexpr (requires(TIdentity_T<Functype>*& PtrRef) { PtrRef = &Name<CppStruct>; }) /* assignment to RefPtr shouldn't be needed, but is a workaround for MSVC bug: https://developercommunity.microsoft.com/t/Compiler-fails-overload-resolution-when/10939568 */ \
1646 { \
1647 Result |= EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags::Name; \
1648 }
1649 UE_FOREACH_FAKE_VTABLE_FUNC(UE_VTABLE_SETFLAG)
1650 #undef UE_VTABLE_SETFLAG
1651
1652 return Result;
1653 }
1654
1655 struct FStructOpsFakeVTable
1656 {
1657 // These flags will indicate which functions are present in the HandlingFunctions array.
1658 EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags Flags;
1659
1661 FCapabilities Capabilities;
1662
1663// MSVC doesn't like zero-sized arrays in the middle of structs
1664#ifndef _MSC_VER
1665 // One function pointer will exist in this array for every corresponding flag in Flags.
1666 // The function pointer types will be different, depending on the required signature, and
1667 // will need to be cast to the right type before being called.
1668 void (*HandlingFunctions[0])();
1669#endif
1670
1671 // Retrieves a handling func associated with a particular flag.
1672 template <EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags FuncFlag>
1673 UE_REWRITE auto GetHandlingFunc() const
1674 {
1675 // Ensure a single flag is passed
1676 static_assert(EnumNumSetFlags(FuncFlag) == 1);
1677
1678PRAGMA_DISABLE_CAST_FUNCTION_TYPE_MISMATCH_WARNINGS
1679 return (typename THandlingFunctionType<FuncFlag>::Type*)this->GetHandlingFuncImpl(FuncFlag);
1680PRAGMA_ENABLE_CAST_FUNCTION_TYPE_MISMATCH_WARNINGS
1681 }
1682
1683 private:
1684 void (*GetHandlingFuncImpl(EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags FuncFlag) const)()
1685 {
1686 // Ensure that the fake vtable actually contains an entry for the requested function
1687 check(!!(this->Flags & FuncFlag));
1688
1689 // Mask off all higher flags
1690 uint32 StructFlagsInt = (uint32)this->Flags;
1691 StructFlagsInt &= (uint32)FuncFlag - 1;
1692
1693 // The number of remaining flags will be the index of the function into the function table.
1694 // Hopefully this turns into a popcnt.
1695 uint32 Index = 0;
1696 while (StructFlagsInt != 0)
1697 {
1698 StructFlagsInt &= StructFlagsInt - 1;
1699 ++Index;
1700 }
1701
1702#ifdef _MSC_VER
1703 // Ensure that the end of the struct is where the start of the function pointer array in TStructOpsFakeVTable will be.
1704 static_assert(alignof(FStructOpsFakeVTable) == alignof(void(*)()));
1705 return ((void(**)())(this + 1))[Index];
1706#else
1707 return this->HandlingFunctions[Index];
1708#endif
1709 }
1710 };
1711
1712 template <auto... Funcs>
1713 struct TStructOpsFakeVTable : public FStructOpsFakeVTable
1714 {
1715 TTuple<decltype(Funcs)...> Functions;
1716 };
1717
1718 template <>
1719 struct TStructOpsFakeVTable<> : public FStructOpsFakeVTable
1720 {
1721 };
1722
1723 // This represents an array of function pointers to handling functions and a header describing the capabilities
1724 // of the struct. Only one pointer exists per handling function. The index of the handling function is the index
1725 // of the set bit in the capabilities.
1726 //
1727 // Example: a struct S containing HasDestructor and HasIdentical would be laid out like this in memory:
1728 // ComputedPropertyFlags
1729 // HasSerializerObjectReferences
1730 // ...: false
1731 // HasDestructor: true
1732 // ...: false
1733 // HasIdentical: true
1734 // ...: false
1735 // void(*HandlingFunctions[2]): { &Destruct<S>, &Identical<S> }
1736 //
1737 template <typename CppStruct, auto... Funcs>
1738 inline constexpr const TStructOpsFakeVTable<Funcs...> TStructOpsFakeVTableInstance =
1739 {
1740 {
1741 GetStructOpsFakeVTableFlags<CppStruct>(),
1742 GetCapabilities<CppStruct>()
1743 },
1744 MakeTuple(Funcs...)
1745 };
1746 template <typename CppStruct>
1747 inline constexpr const TStructOpsFakeVTable<> TStructOpsFakeVTableInstance<CppStruct> =
1748 {
1749 {
1750 GetStructOpsFakeVTableFlags<CppStruct>(),
1751 GetCapabilities<CppStruct>()
1752 }
1753 };
1754
1755 template <typename CppStruct, EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags Flags, auto... Funcs>
1756 struct TStructOpsFakeVTableForTypeImpl : TStructOpsFakeVTableForTypeImpl<CppStruct, EnumRemoveLowestSetFlag(Flags), Funcs..., THandlingFunctionPtr<CppStruct, EnumLowestSetFlag(Flags)>::Value>
1757 {
1758 };
1759
1760 template <typename CppStruct, auto... Funcs>
1761 struct TStructOpsFakeVTableForTypeImpl<CppStruct, EStructOpsFakeVTableFlags::None, Funcs...>
1762 {
1763 inline static constexpr const FStructOpsFakeVTable* Value = &TStructOpsFakeVTableInstance<CppStruct, Funcs...>;
1764 };
1765
1766 template <typename CppStruct>
1767 using TStructOpsFakeVTableForType = TStructOpsFakeVTableForTypeImpl<CppStruct, GetStructOpsFakeVTableFlags<CppStruct>()>;
1768}

2949 // Index is the internal index into the Enum array, and is not useful outside of the Enum system
2950 // Value is the value set in the Enum Class in C++ or Blueprint
2951 // Enums can be sparse, which means that not every valid Index is a proper Value, and they are not necessarily equal
2952 // It is not safe to cast an Index to a Enum Class, always do that with a Value instead

2955 inline int32 GetIndexByValue(int64 InValue) const
2956 {
2957 for (int32 i = 0; i < Names.Num(); ++i)
2958 {

2961 return i;
2962 }
2963 }
2964 return INDEX_NONE;
2965 }

2970 check(Names.IsValidIndex(Index));

3473 // Helper function for UHT - calculate max enum value when UHT was not able to parse all enum values
3474 consteval static inline int64 CalculateMaxEnumValue(std::initializer_list<int64> Values, EEnumFlags InFlags)
3475 {
3476 check(Values.size() != 0); // UHT should only generate a call to this when there are values
3477 if (EnumHasAllFlags(InFlags, EEnumFlags::Flags))
3478 {
3479 int64 CombinedFlags = 0;
3480 for (int64 Val : Values)
3481 {
3482 if (FMath::IsPowerOfTwo(Val))
3483 {
3484 CombinedFlags |= Val;
3485 }
3486 }
3487 return 1 + CombinedFlags;
3488 }
3489 return 1 + *Algo::MaxElement(Values);
3490 }

3493 class FNameData
3494 {
3495 // Tag bit to show wehther a pointer is dynamically allocated, or points to a static allocation
3496 static inline constexpr UPTRINT TagDynamic = 0x1;
3497 // Mask to retrieve a readable pointer from the tagged pointer regardless of whether it is static or dynamic
3498 static inline constexpr UPTRINT MaskPointer = ~0x1;
3499 union
3500 {
3501#if UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3502 // Immutable array of string constants from UHT. This union member is active until full compiled-in UObject construction in ProcessNewlyLoadedUObjects
3503 const UTF8CHAR* const* StaticNamesUTF8;
3504#endif // UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3505 // Tagged FName* pointer, noting whether array is dynamically allocated
3506 UPTRINT TaggedNames = 0;
3507 };
3508 union
3509 {
3510#if UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3511 // Immutable array of values from UHT. This union member may be active for the entire process lifetime.
3512 const int64* StaticValues;
3513#endif // UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3514 // Tagged int64* pointer noting whether array is dynamically allocated
3515 UPTRINT TaggedValues = 0;
3516 };
3517 // Both arrays contain same number of values
3518 int32 NumValues = 0;
3519
3520 void DeleteNames();
3521 void DeleteValues();
3522
3523 FName* AllocateNames(int32 InNum);
3524 int64* AllocateValues(int32 InNum);
3525
3526 public:
3527 UE_NONCOPYABLE(FNameData)
3528 constexpr FNameData() = default;
3529#if UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3530 consteval FNameData(int32 InNum, const UTF8CHAR* const* InStaticNamesUTF8, const int64* InValues)
3531 : StaticNamesUTF8(InStaticNamesUTF8)
3532 , StaticValues(InValues)
3533 , NumValues(InNum)
3534 {
3535 }
3536#endif // UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3537 ~FNameData();
3538
3539 [[nodiscard]] inline int32 Num() const
3540 {
3541 return NumValues;
3542 }
3543
3544 [[nodiscard]] inline bool IsValidIndex(int32 Index) const
3545 {
3546 return Index >= 0 && Index < NumValues;
3547 }
3548
3549 [[nodiscard]] inline TPair<FName, int64> operator[](int32 Index) const
3550 {
3551 check(IsValidIndex(Index));
3552 return { GetNames()[Index], GetValues()[Index] };
3553 }
3554
3555#if UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3556 // Initialize from constinit data
3557 void InitializeFromCompiledInData();
3558#endif //UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
3559 // Initialize from legacy serialization of names without values
3560 void Initialize(const TArray<FName>& InNames);
3561 // Initialize from legacy serialization of names with byte values
3562 void Initialize(const TArray<TPair<FName, uint8>>& InNames);
3563 // Initialize from names and int64 values
3564 void Initialize(const TArray<TPair<FName, int64>>& InNames);
3565 // Initialize from names and int64 values with a placeholder to generate a max element
3566 COREUOBJECT_API void InitializeWithPlaceholder(const TArray<TPair<FName, int64>>& InNames, int64 MaxValue);
3567 // If necessary, replace values with sequential values counting up from zero
3568 COREUOBJECT_API void MakeValuesSequentialFromZero();
3569 // Deallocate arrays - ConstInit objects should not delete the values as they are a static array created by UHT.
3570 COREUOBJECT_API void Empty();
3571
3572 COREUOBJECT_API void UsePlaceholder(FName InName, int64 InValue);
3573 COREUOBJECT_API void DiscardPlaceholder();

3575 // Get a mutable view over the names
3576 [[nodiscard]] inline TArrayView<FName> GetMutableNames()
3577 {
3578 checkfSlow(!TaggedNames || !!(TaggedNames & TagDynamic), TEXT("This function should only be used after compiled-in enums have copied their static string names into FNames"));
3579 return MakeArrayView(reinterpret_cast<FName*>(TaggedNames & MaskPointer), NumValues);
3580 }
3581
3582 // Get an immutable view over the names
3583 [[nodiscard]] inline TConstArrayView<FName> GetNames() const
3584 {
3585 checkfSlow(!TaggedNames || !!(TaggedNames & TagDynamic), TEXT("This function should only be used after compiled-in enums have copied their static string names into FNames"));
3586 return MakeConstArrayView(reinterpret_cast<const FName*>(TaggedNames & MaskPointer), NumValues);
3587 }
3588
3589 // Get an immutable view over the values
3590 [[nodiscard]] inline TConstArrayView<int64> GetValues() const
3591 {
3592 return MakeConstArrayView(reinterpret_cast<int64*>(TaggedValues & MaskPointer), NumValues);
3593 }

3595 // Read-only ranged-for support.
3596 struct FIteratorEnd
3597 {
3598 };
3599 struct FIterator
3600 {
3601 void operator++()
3602 {
3603 ++Index;
3604 }
3605
3606 bool operator==(FIteratorEnd) const
3607 {
3608 return Index >= Num;
3609 }
3610
3611#if !PLATFORM_COMPILER_HAS_GENERATED_COMPARISON_OPERATORS
3612 bool operator!=(FIteratorEnd) const
3613 {
3614 return Index < Num;
3615 }
3616#endif
3617
3618 TPair<FName, int64> operator*() const
3619 {
3620 return { Names[Index], Values[Index] };
3621 }
3622
3623 int32 Index = 0;
3624 int32 Num;
3625 const FName* Names;
3626 const int64* Values;
3627 };
3628
3629 inline FIterator begin() const
3630 {
3631 return FIterator{
3632 .Num = Num(),
3633 .Names = reinterpret_cast<FName*>(TaggedNames & MaskPointer),
3634 .Values = reinterpret_cast<int64*>(TaggedValues & MaskPointer)
3635 };
3636 }
3637 inline FIteratorEnd end() const
3638 {
3639 return FIteratorEnd();
3640 }
3641 } Names;

5065enum class EInstancePropertyValueFlags
5066{
5067 None = 0x00,
5068
5069 // if set, then this property causes an instance to be created, otherwise this is just a pointer to a uobject that should be remapped if the object is instanced for some other property
5070 CausesInstancing = 0x01,
5071
5072 // if set, instance the reference to the subobjectroot, so far only delegates remap a self reference
5073 AllowSelfReference = 0x02,
5074
5075 // if set, then we do not create a new instance, but we will reassign one if there is already a mapping in the table
5076 DoNotCreateNewInstance = 0x04
5077};

5210 void ForEachObjectInstance(Predicate Pred)
5211 {
5212 for (TMap<UObject*, UObject*>::TIterator It(SourceToDestinationMap); It; ++It)
5213 {
5214 UObject* InstancedObject = It.Value();
5215 Pred(InstancedObject);
5216 }
5217 }

5222 void EnableSubobjectInstancing( bool bEnabled )
5223 {
5224 if (bEnabled)
5225 {
5226 InstancingOptions &= ~EObjectInstancingGraphOptions::DisableInstancing;
5227 }
5228 else
5229 {
5230 InstancingOptions |= EObjectInstancingGraphOptions::DisableInstancing;
5231 }
5232 }
5233
5237 bool IsSubobjectInstancingEnabled() const
5238 {
5239 return !(InstancingOptions & EObjectInstancingGraphOptions::DisableInstancing);
5240 }

5247 bLoadingObject = bIsLoading;

5254 {
5255 SubobjectInstantiationExclusionList.Add(Property);
5256 }
5257
5261 bool IsPropertyInSubobjectExclusionList(const FProperty* Property) const
5262 {
5263 return SubobjectInstantiationExclusionList.Contains(Property);
5264 }
